clauses.text: bind shipping from ShippingPrice when HasPrice
require pricing.request_id == input.request_id and (not HasPrice or shipping.request_id == input.request_id) else "CHECKOUT_RESPONSE_MISMATCH"
require not HasPrice or shipping.option_id == input.shipping.option_id else "CHECKOUT_SHIPPING_MISMATCH"
require not Quoted or (present(pricing.price_id) and present(pricing.subtotal_minor) and present(shipping.fee_minor)) else "CHECKOUT_INCOMPLETE_QUOTE"
